atoms.text: Now Maxie is going to show you around some villages.

instruction.text: Select the three images of villages.

feedback.finish: Correct! Villages are usually very small and have few buildings, as not many people live there.
feedback.wrong: This is an iceberg in the ocean.

instruction.text: Maxie wants to show you some villages in the UK. This is Castle Combe in England. Select the river to learn more.

feedback.end: Villages are made up of only a few houses and shops. They usually also have a place of worship, such as a church.

instruction.text: This is Tintern in Wales. Select the hills to learn more.

feedback.end: Despite its small size, Tintern is well-known for its abbey ruins and the natural scenery around it. Many villages are in the countryside far away from big cities.

instruction.text: Now we’re on the island of Santorini in Greece. This is Oia. Select the sunset to learn more.
instruction.sound: Now we’re on the island of Santtorini in Greece. This is Oia. Select the sunset to learn more.

end.text: In Oia, houses are closely packed together. There are many similar buildings in Santorini — houses in the same area are usually built in the same style!
end.sound: In Eeah, houses are closely packed together. There are many similar buildings in Santtorini — houses in the same area are usually built in the same style!

instruction.text: Maxie wants to know what you will normally find in villages. Drag each image to the correct group.

hint.text: Select an image to hear what it is.

feedback.finish: Villages might be small, but they usually have places where the community can come together. There’s also lots of space where you can play!

instruction.text: Let’s do some fieldwork! Maxie wants to find out what there is in this village. Select the correct places on the village map.
You are now on Park Lane with Maxie. Answer Maxie’s questions.
